about: Cutling 2.0 release posts (board ASG104), Dec 1 to 3, every platform. Files in ~/Downloads/Claude/cutling-2-release-posts/. Times WIB (UTC+7), odd minutes, each after 2.0's release at Dec 1 07:00 WIB. Nothing is scheduled before Cutling 2.0 reads READY_FOR_SALE and the owner's go on the review page. Day one is new (a film cut from real recordings of the 2.0 build, and a carousel in the store frames' look); days two and three are ASG164's Five names and Five taps with their films unchanged, their captions saying "blank" as the release notes do, and an X post added to each. No film or caption names a price. This file takes the place of the two Cutling films' rows in films-2/posts.json, so each goes out once. Review page: https://claude.ai/artifact/L2s3wTyLfVwEL8jTuQ4wVz (built by review.py from this file).

films.title: What's new in 2.0
films.what: The five things 2.0 adds, each over a real recording of the 2.0 build: a reply that asks for the name (Messages), a date that fills itself in, a reply written like a note with a bold title, a list and a highlight, the grid holding 5,000, and a formatted key typed by one tap. The carousel says the same five in the look of the App Store frames.

posts.text:
Cutling 2.0 is out. Five things changed:

1. A saved reply can ask for the name before it types itself.
2. Dates fill in on the day you send them.
3. You can write a reply like a note, with bold, highlight and lists.
4. There's room for 5,000 texts and 500 images, up from 100 and 25.
5. Every key types, formatted ones too.

Cutling is a keyboard for the text you type again and again, on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Which of the five would you use first? Tell me in the comments.

Cutling on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6759476314?pt=127609326&mt=8&ct=yt-release-short

Music: Complicated by Arulo (Mixkit).
#iPhoneTips #iOSApps
